caption: The video captures an overhead close-up of a small fire already burning on dark, charred ground. A flattened cardboard box sits center-left, engulfed in bright orange-yellow flames, while crumpled white tissues lie around it, their edges browning and curling. A small pink scrap with a tiny flame rests at the top center beside a vertical trail of white ash, and rough blackened earth dotted with pale ash fills the right. Throughout the excerpt the flames flicker and change height, and the framing drifts slightly so the box edges toward the left. Near the middle a hand enters from the bottom-left holding a fresh, mostly-white folded sheet and lays it onto the burning box. The newly placed sheet catches fire as its edges darken and flames climb over it. The pink scrap and ash trail remain in place, their small flame only flickering.
